note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). Four portal screens. Costs real money (8 Copilot Credits per page at 0.01 USD, about 10 pages, under 1 USD) and needs a pay-as-you-go billing plan on DEV; everything is removed the same day in teardown.
prepare: # owner signs in: az login (lab subscription, Owner), pac auth below, browser profiles for labadmin (Azure portal, Power Platform admin center, Automation Center) and alex.demo (make.powerautomate.com, SharePoint). Nothing is typed or stored here.
az group create --name rg-mglab-pa-12 --location westeurope --output none

# owner (Azure portal, off camera): Cost Management > Budgets on rg-mglab-pa-12: 30 EUR per month, alert at 80 percent to the lab admin. Resources: the resource group (free) and, after the billing plan, one hidden Power Platform account resource (pay as you go 0.01 USD per Copilot Credit)

# owner (PPAC, demo.md Setup 2): check that DEV is a Production or Sandbox environment; Licensing > Pay-as-you-go plans > New billing plan 'mglab-pa-12' on the lab subscription and rg-mglab-pa-12, select DEV, Save
# owner: start the self-service Power Automate Premium trial for alex.demo (AI Builder action is premium); say so on camera or cut it
# owner (tenant, demo.md Setup 3): site Finance with library Invoice Inbox and the lists Invoice Extractions and Invoices (internal names exactly as in demo.md); sam.demo is the reviewer
pac auth create --name dev --environment $env:DEV_URL   # owner signs in, off camera

# owner (demo.md Setup 4-5): set the connection references and the environment variables (Finance site URL, Reviewer mailbox = sam.demo, thresholds 0.8, 5000, 365); build the extraction flow 'Extract invoice to staging list' in the designer as alex.demo and turn it on

# owner (screen 'extractions'): drop src\samples\invoice-clean.pdf, invoice-scan.png and invoice-mismatch.pdf one by one into Invoice Inbox, then invoice-clean.pdf a second time; run invoice-two-in-one.pdf with Pages = 2-3

screens.name: extract
steps: Select environment DEV and open the flow 'Extract invoice to staging list' in the designer

Open the four actions enough to read: trigger 'When a file is created (properties only)' on Invoice Inbox, 'Get file content', AI Builder 'Extract information from invoices' (Invoice file, Pages) and 'Create item' in Invoice Extractions with the mapped fields
Show the number and date outputs mapped (not the text ones) and the confidence outputs
mask: tenant name in the top bar
site address in the trigger and Create item cards
environment ID in the address bar

screens.name: extractions
steps: Show the Invoice Inbox library with the dropped files, then open the list 'Invoice Extractions'
Show one row per file with InvoiceId, VendorName, InvoiceTotal, dates and the confidence columns side by side
Point at the clean PDF with high scores next to the low-quality scan with lower ones; record whatever the model returns, do not edit values
mask: tenant name in the address bar and the SharePoint header

screens.name: decision
steps: Capture 1: the Invoice Extractions list with the Decision column filled by the triage flow: auto-post for the clean invoice, review for the mismatch and the scan, reject for the second upload of the same invoice
Capture 2: the Invoices list with the one posted row
Capture 3: as sam.demo, the Outlook message from the flow's 'Ask reviewer' action for a review row
Optional: set the environment variable 'Amount limit' to 500 for one run to show OVERLIMIT (clean invoice total is 747.60) and set it back
mask: tenant name in the address bar and headers

screens.name: cost
steps: Open Automation Center > Monitor > AI Builder activity and show the predicts of this session with the Consumption value of each, in Copilot Credits
Open the Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Pay-as-you-go plans and show the plan linked to DEV
mask: environment ID in the address bar

teardown: # owner (PPAC): remove DEV from the billing plan 'mglab-pa-12', then delete the plan
# owner (Cost Management): note the day's charge in the README; delete the flows and solutions in DEV, the lists, the library and the site Finance; let the Power Automate Premium trial expire
blocked: The cost screen and every AI Builder run need a pay-as-you-go billing plan (Copilot Credits) linked to DEV, which is not set up (series/LAB.md: owner's decision, about 1 USD for the session), and DEV must be a Production or Sandbox environment, not Trial or Developer.
